units.source_text: 真一扮“童男”乘坐祇园节的彩车，已是十几年前的事了。

en.t: It had already been more than ten years since Shinichi dressed as a “chigo” and rode on a float in the Gion Festival.

units.source_text: 然而龙助如今还时不时揶揄真一，管他叫“童男”。

en.t: Even so, Ryusuke still teases Shinichi from time to time nowadays, calling him “chigo.”

units.source_text: 或许是真一身上至今还保留着当年那股“童男”般可爱而温存的性格吧……

en.t: Perhaps Shinichi still retains even now that endearing and gentle “chigo”-like nature from those days...
